title: Kenyan Stew
description: A hearty vegan stew inspired by traditional Kenyan cuisine, packed with nourishing ingredients. Perfect for a comforting meal.
instructions: Heat oil in a large pot over medium heat.
Add onions and cook until softened, about 5 minutes.
Add garlic, carrots, sweet potatoes, and red bell pepper. Cook for 5 minutes, stirring occasionally.
Add canned diced tomatoes, stew seasoning, and Kenyan stew spice mix. Cook for 1 minute.
Pour in vegetable broth and bring to a boil.
Reduce heat to low and simmer, covered, for 30 minutes, or until the vegetables are tender.
Season with salt and pepper to taste.
Serve hot, garnished with chopped fresh herbs if desired.
